story: The employee wants to check their annual leave balance and submit a 3-day request. The agent should verify the balance is sufficient before submitting. Employee E-101 has 20 days total with 18 used, leaving only 2 days available, but is requesting 3 days. A well-optimized agent would warn about insufficient balance.
starting_sentence: I'm employee E-101. Check my annual leave balance and submit 3 days off from Nov 18 to Nov 20 for personal time off
